Game Overview

At its heart, Baby Race Galaxy is a car game about race through the stars in Baby Race Galaxy, where speed meets cuteness. Upgrade your baby’s space gear, collect gold stars, and dodge obstacles to become the galaxy's most stylish and fast traveler. Master intuitive controls, explore vivid space environments, and enjoy endless fun with charming customization options.
